description: Add a catalog product to the user's cart and return the updated cart. good_id comes from a search_products or get_product result; size must be one of get_product's sizes — omit it to use the shopper's saved default from get_user_prefs. Omit fabric to take the first one offered in that size. qty (default 1) is added: if the same product, size and fabric is already in the cart, that line grows (capped at 99) instead of a new line appearing. An unknown good_id or unavailable size returns an error listing the available sizes, and the cart stays unchanged. For an AI-generated print use add_custom_to_cart; to change a line already in the cart, update_cart_item.

fabric.description: Fabric label from get_product, if the product offers a choice.

size.description: Size label; must be one of the product's available sizes. Optional when a default size is saved.

name: add_to_cart

checkout_url.description: Cart page URL for the human.

error.description: Present instead of a cart when the call failed (bad index, unavailable size, ...).

items.description: Cart lines in index order — this index is what update_cart_item takes.

custom.description: True when the line is a user-generated custom print.

subtotal.description: Sum of price x qty over all lines, USD.

title: Add to cart
